sections.title: Default costs by route overview
sections.content:
## Purpose

Default costs by route are used to declare the amount of each cost type per route and effective date.

## Access

**Menu:** Driver salary > Default costs by route

![](/uploads/98a34644635ca906fa4fd326.png)

The list shows the default costs already declared per route.

![](/uploads/0afa9c8241977eafd43d5ca1.png)

sections.title: Creating a cost by route
sections.content:
### Step 1

Click **New**.

![](/uploads/6c35019832383e166033b43b.png)

### Step 2

Enter the cost information.

![](/uploads/0ed5be781aa51f97a6413be5.png)

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Effective date | Date the cost starts applying. |
| Route | Route the cost value applies to. |
| Cost type | Type of cost to configure. |
| Amount | Default amount. |
| Description | Additional notes. |
| Company | Company it applies to. |

![](/uploads/17e0f4d816e85b2e13434ac8.png)

### Step 3

Click **Save manually** to finish.

![](/uploads/1e866f7106816c9a1c6f5c28.png)
